purpose: Verified contract for assembling a human-auditable property case file from validated retrieval-session material.
core_principle: QUESTION → PROPERTY → DATE → CHRONOLOGY → SOURCES/DOCUMENTS → FACTS → LAW → CONFLICTS → SUFFICIENCY → ROUTE/DEADLINE → ANSWER → TRACE → AUDIT
required_distinctions: event date vs document date vs registration date
publication_rule: A case file can be assembled with unresolved matters, but a verified answer may only be generated when the linked answer-state publication gate is satisfied.
review_rule: The case file must allow a reviewer to reconstruct why each material answer component was included or withheld.
verification_boundary: Assembly preserves and organizes evidence and analysis; it does not independently establish the underlying property or legal truth.
